duration.description: Global default auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds for provideRiviniaToast({ duration }). Omit to keep the 5000 default.

maxVisible.description: Maximum simultaneously visible toasts for provideRiviniaToast({ maxVisible }). Omit to keep the 5 default.

project.description: Angular CLI project name — only for multi-app workspaces. Defaults to the workspace default project.
